links.outcome: Test-retest reproducibility of ChatGPT answers to identical questions 14 days apart
links.effect: Cohen's kappa showed moderate agreement for binary questions and low agreement for multiple-choice questions. Overall accuracy changed from 88.0% to 93.0% (p>0.05).
links.quote: Cohen's kappa analysis indicated moderate agreement for binary questions and low agreement for multiple-choice questions.

links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM answers against current 2025 ESC/EACTS valvular heart disease guidelines
links.effect: Binary accuracy was 96.7% at both time points. Multiple-choice accuracy rose from 75.0% to 87.5%. Overall accuracy rose from 88.0% to 93.0%.
links.quote: However, the relatively high initial error rate in multiple-choice questions represents a limitation for clinical reliability.

screen.reason: Evaluates the test-retest consistency and accuracy of ChatGPT on guideline-derived multiple-choice and binary questions without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
